title.description: Title of the position, e.g. Backend Developer.

employeeId.description: Id of the LLM employee holding the position, i.e. the name of its folder in .aico/employees. Absent when the directors hold it, the people working on the repository, whom git names.
employeeId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens

title: AICo position
description: Configuration of a position, in .aico/positions/<position-id>/config.json. Its job description lives next to it, in description.md.
